observationsNotFindings: Decision item 2 ends 'Naming is not execution. Not QUALIFIED.' I tested this as a potential mis-transplant, because DR-111 has no named gate: both of its leftover obligations carry existingGate 'none', so there is no harness identifier for the phrase to refer to. In COORD the phrase appears only twice, both in condition-4 *naming candidate* entries (gate-harness-naming.v6, dr117-ee-gate-naming.v3) where it is directly apt, and the adopted D-176 — the closest sibling on this branch — does not carry it at all. Not a finding, for three reasons: the statement is true as a general principle, it asserts nothing about DR-111 having a gate, and any misreading it could seed (that DR-111's remainders are named condition-4 obligations, which would bear on gate 3) is foreclosed by the very next sentence, Decision item 3, which states gates 2 and 3 do not hold. The D-176 draft carried the same phrase and it was condensed away at adoption; the coordinator may wish to do the same here, but it blocks nothing.

The measured-inputs table cites COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md and 'file 08' by short name. Not a finding: file 08 carries an explicit disambiguating definition at lines 60-61, COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md resolves uniquely in the repo, and both digests were verified against those resolutions — the same convention as the adopted siblings.

Decision item 3 asserts gates 2 and 3 fail but does not state gate 1's status. Not a finding: D-056 eligibility requires ALL gates, so two verified failures suffice. Separately, Class A is genuinely unavailable here because it requires 'no express reservation' and contract v5's numericWindows is expressly RESERVED — so the entry's refusal to open it is correct rather than merely cautious.
